title: Data Center Is Fined $1.1 Million for Operating 62 Power Generators

reports.title: Data Center Is Fined $1.1 Million for Operating 62 Power Generators

summary:
New Jersey fined DataOne $1.07 million for running 62 natural gas generators without required permits to install or operate at its Vineland data center. State inspectors found the 2,000 kilowatt generators in late July at the construction site. Officials said it was the largest fine ever issued to a data center operator in New Jersey, and it was for violating the state's Air Pollution Control Act.

The planned data center is a 2.6 million square foot complex that will need 350 megawatts of power, enough for a medium size city, and is scheduled for completion at the end of the year. Some of it is already in use. It has drawn complaints, including a federal lawsuit from homeowners over persistent noise and violation orders from the Cumberland County Health Department for excessive noise.
